_comment: Read by evals/run_filing.py through eval_history.corpus_provenance, so every `suite: "filing"` row in evals/history.ndjson says which fixture produced it. Lives at the mini repo's ROOT on purpose, exactly like evals/corpus/PROVENANCE.json: the content zones are wiki/, sources/ and views/, so nothing here is ever indexed as a page, linted as one, or visible to a capture.
why: The filing golden measures the ONE writer of the knowledge repo. Its score is only comparable across runs if every run filed into the same repo, under the same brief, judged by the same contract linter — so the whole mini repo is committed and frozen rather than assembled on demand. Same argument evals/corpus/PROVENANCE.json makes for the retrieval and QA corpus, applied to a fixture that is also an INPUT to the thing being measured rather than only a target for it.
stigmergy_sha_note: The ONE knowledge-repo commit every frozen copy in this tree matches byte for byte — the linter, both skills and the four templates. Recording it here is what lets a future reader answer 'which version of the librarian's brief scored this?', the question the series exists to answer and the one a fixture assembled at run time cannot. It is not the commit each copy was physically taken at: the librarian brief's bytes exist only at this commit, while the others are identical at this one and at its predecessor, so this is the single sha that describes the whole tree truthfully. Each FROZEN.md records the same one.
frozen_copies_note: Byte-for-byte copies of the knowledge repo's own files, each with a FROZEN.md beside it. They are NOT drift-guarded against the live originals, and that is the difference between this fixture and tests/librarian/fixtures/repo/: a drift guard keeps a test honest about the present, while a yardstick has to stay still. See .claude/tools/FROZEN.md. This list enumerates exactly the copies that carry a FROZEN.md marker, one for one — a keyless test pins that pairing, so a fourth entry here without a marker beside it is a failure rather than a note.
frozen_templates_note: ops/templates/*.md are byte-for-byte copies too, at the same stigmergy_sha, and they are listed here rather than in frozen_copies for one reason: they are placeholder skeletons carrying no knowledge and no contract, so there is nothing about them a FROZEN.md would say that this sentence does not. They still matter — the librarian skill sends the agent to read them, so a fixture that invented its own would brief the agent differently from production — and they are frozen under the same rule as everything else in this tree: never resynced to make a capture pass.
content: Synthetic throughout, except the three frozen copies above. The organizations (Northwind Freight, Quillon Labs, Marlowe Publishing) are invented, deliberately share no name with evals/corpus's set (aurora-systems, borealis-logistics, cascade-foods, delta-robotics, globex, initech, hooli, everest-analytics, foxglove-health) or with tests/librarian's Acme Corp, so the three fixtures can never be confused for one another, and carry no figures of their own. ops/entity-registry.json and ops/acl.json are synthetic content written in the real on-disk dialect. ops/templates/ are the knowledge repo's own placeholder skeletons, which carry no knowledge — the librarian skill instructs the agent to read them, so a fixture that invented its own would brief the agent differently from production. Nothing here is anyone's real data; keep it that way if this fixture ever grows.
pages_are_ordinary_knowledge: The agent under measurement READS these pages while it files, so nothing in a page body may describe the measurement. A page that says which facet it exists to probe, what a correct filing would do with it, or which rule the librarian skill applies to it is a page handing the model the answer — and the score it produces is not a score. Every rationale about this fixture lives here or in expected/expectations.json's `why` fields, surfaces the agent never sees. The shape below is what the pages must keep; the reasons are what they must not say.

why_the_pages_are_shaped_this_way.three entities: Two would be enough to prove a backend can choose between them; the third — barely mentioned by any capture — is what makes a wrong choice visible as a wrong choice rather than as a coin landing the other way up. The figure-dense capture anchors to it, which keeps that case's anchoring independent of the organization every other capture talks about.
why_the_pages_are_shaped_this_way.no figures on any page: A number on a fixture page could be copied onto a filed page and read as supported by a capture that never carried it, which would make the figure-dense case measure the wrong thing. Every figure in a scored run comes from the capture.
why_the_pages_are_shaped_this_way.distinct lines of business: Haulage, materials research and trade publishing, so no capture in the set is genuinely ambiguous between two entities. An instrument whose own fixture is ambiguous measures the ambiguity, not the backend.
why_the_pages_are_shaped_this_way.an existing note with an open question: wiki/notes/Northwind Freight Onboarding.md records the weekend-cover question without answering it, and it existed before any capture arrived. Both properties are load-bearing for the declared-edit case: 'an additive edit to an EXISTING page' is only a real claim against a page nobody created in the same commit, and a continuation of a genuine gap is not an arbitrary one.
why_the_pages_are_shaped_this_way.a decision page as well as notes: It gives the mini repo a second wiki/ zone with a real page in it, so a capture filed as a decision lands beside something rather than into an empty folder — and a second wikilink target, so a filed page has somewhere legitimate to point other than an entity page, which the librarian skill forbids declaring an edit on.
why_the_pages_are_shaped_this_way.no machine-owned frontmatter: No submitted_by, no acl, no content_hash on any page here. None of them was filed by the librarian; they are hand-authored, exactly as pages a steward wrote would be.

unregistered_names.Halcyon Grid: F02's unresolvable organization — registering it would delete the parking case

editing_policy: Do not edit this tree to make a capture pass. Every entry already in evals/history.ndjson was measured against exactly these bytes, and a silent change re-grades all of them. A change that is genuinely warranted (the real brief moved far enough that this fixture stops representing production) retires the series and starts a new one, recorded in evals/README.md with a fresh baseline row.
